newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX Aug div contingent on merger status.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX Aug div contingent on merger status.

text.p: NYNEX Corp said Friday its August quarterly dividend will be $0.59 per share unless the company's pending merger with Bell Atlantic Corp is completed by the close of business on July 10.

Should the merger close before that deadline, NYNEX will not pay a dividend, the company said. In that case, NYNEX shareholders will receive 0.768 of a share of Bell Atlantic stock for each share held of NYNEX, and they will be paid a dividend by Bell Atlantic of $0.77 per share.
As a result, the dividend will be equivalent to what shareholders would have received from NYNEX, it said.
If NYNEX does pay a dividend, it will be payable on August 1 to shareholders of record on July 10, the company said.
